description: Suspension for non-payment is preceded by written notice and an opportunity to cure.
source_document: Legal Constitution, Lawyer Review Version L1.10 — docs/02-legal-domain/LEGAL_CONSTITUTION_L1.10.md
source_quote: Before suspending service for non-payment, the customer should receive appropriate written notice and a cure period ... Unacceptable: Suspension for non-payment with no prior written notice or cure opportunity.
